affinity.notes: The gold motion trail reads as weapon movement rather than elemental alignment.

anatomy.notes: Overlapping dark limbs and armor make the appendage count and weapon grip difficult to parse.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "fast melee duelist" does not semantically communicate Spiracle-Switch Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: The bright sweeping blade trail clearly signals a fast lateral melee strike.

finish.notes: Dense red-black microdetail merges across the torso and limbs, reducing silhouette clarity.

framing.notes: The crouched full-body stance fits the portrait and preserves the action arc.

identity.notes: Blind perception "armored insectoid blade fighter" semantically identifies insectoids/insectoid-elite-drone.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
